title.narrative: SAHAYATRA: Strengthening Civil Society for Resilient and Inclusive Education Governance in Nepal

description.narrative: The specific objectives of the proposed action are to increase inclusive access to quality education and learning for marginalized girls and CwDs in the COVID and post-COVID context, enhance local authorities accountability for resilient and gender-responsive education governance, and improve civil society influence and engagement in promoting rights to education and advocating for resilient and gender-responsive education governance. The achievement of these specific objectives will contribute to the overall objective of Inclusive quality education for marginalized girls and CwDs through resilient, gender-responsive education governance enhanced by CSO engagement
